You should be putting in about 50 working hours a week.
texts.6cdaa8d7-4f0d-42cd-bca0-bbe6eddbf8c7: hould be putting in about 50 working hours a week. We are too small for anyone to be putting in less than that and any more and you are working too much. This may fluctuate as the weeks go by (sometimes if we’re really busy it may be a 100 hour week!), but you should aim for about 50 hours as a rolling average. These hours can be spread out across the week as you like (including weekends), but if it's going to be very unusual please let the team know. Generally the expectation is once you send

Asynchronous and Remote Collaboration Working Pseudonymously Being a Bitcoiner has potential long term risks because it threatens the powerful global money system. As such our team works privately and pseudonymously and we must all respect this completely. All meetings are compulsory but we are strictly voice chats or text
texts.d0098266-abb6-480d-8785-6f15543d037a: compulsory but we are strictly voice chats or text meetings only and will never ask any team member to turn on their camera during a meeting. That said, this working style is not for everyone. If you want to have a video or in person meetings and the other African Bitcoiner is open to that then please do so. However, you must always respect the wishes of the most private person and that means other meetings besides text or audio (ie, video meetings). Meetings must be well documented - their
texts.74192b18-c006-45ca-b5cc-6c6242de942c: eetings). Meetings must be well documented - their keynotes and outcomes must be captured as text and put in the appropriate Discord channel. Most importantly, you have to respect everyone’s privacy. Their secret is only as safe as you are trustworthy. Overdue Task and Roadblock Policy If your task is overdue and you haven't raised a roadblock in advance, the consequence will be a warning. The roadblock system is essential, if a roadblock is raised, the manager is responsible for either resolving
texts.9740584a-b70a-46fd-92db-48103f8903ab: d, the manager is responsible for either resolving the issue or moving the deadline to prevent the task from becoming overdue. We believe that accepting one overdue task is the same as accepting 100. It’s black and white. This system ensures accountability and engagement, allowing challenges to be addressed proactively while keeping everyone aligned with expectations. texts.ae80f1de-235b-4058-ae30-3e38da9e2c18: ful continent and as such there are often peculiar things that happen that get in the way of our work. texts.18f879af-9f28-4bf4-892d-f68906093cff: o you so rather than sitting twiddling your thumbs waiting for things to improve, get out and about with other aspects of your life and catch up another time. People & Culture 4.1. Principles We Value and Interactions We don’t want to be one of those organizations with a laundry list of values that no one can remember - so we only have 5. However, there are a few key principles that we value highly as important parts of our culture. Here they are: We are hungry for feedback Whether it’s from our
texts.1a356967-fefb-4a3f-8e3a-fed4ddd47451: : We are hungry for feedback Whether it’s from our community or our customers or our team mates, we are always wanting to know how we can be better. We have a bias for action because action gives us feedback which allows us to learn and improve. Every interaction should come with a request for feedback, particularly when dealing with the outside world. Curiosity Our people have to be hungry for knowledge. Always learning, always growing, all the time. You simply can’t have a growth mindset
texts.00b0ee43-5f0d-4f37-9951-130d461b750f: l the time. You simply can’t have a growth mindset without it. We love it when people say “I don’t know how to do that, yet”. It communicates an honest vulnerability and a strong desire to learn. These are our kind of people. An important note. Learning is HARD. It doesn’t feel good all the time. It’s not a nice feeling when you don’t have the answer or keep making mistakes. But this is how we grow and improve. In our team you should feel safe to make these mistakes of learning provided you are
texts.ccb2c381-ca0f-43e3-ade6-f017c0b5480d: o make these mistakes of learning provided you are living our values and not repeating the same mistake. If we aren’t failing some of the time then we are learning none of the time. It’s hard, but if you want to be better, run towards that pain. Psychological safety In keeping with mistakes and failure being an important part of learning, we want to reiterate that we are a safe space to make these mistakes. Many rockets will explode before the first one lands on Mars and each one of those
texts.0b67d4eb-774e-4941-ac9b-c13335ed1c7c: the first one lands on Mars and each one of those failures gives us a lesson we can’t get anywhere else. It’s important however to always live our Values at all times. For example, in the pursuit of innovation and trying new things, it’s not acceptable to be unkind or unaccountable. It’s also not acceptable to keep making the same mistakes because that’s just sloppy work. But when you shoot for the moon and come crashing down short, we want to be the people who applaud your effort because
texts.3a6608cf-e0f9-41d6-b502-f95cf179e3fa: t to be the people who applaud your effort because eventually we know you will change the world. As long as you’re giving it your best, we’re right behind you no matter what happens. Paying Attention Working over text has its pros and cons. texts.e78654ab-0906-4335-8e72-65fcad0bbf5f: miss an important piece of communication that may be mixed up in a few other things. Pay attention. texts.25ebb9ff-081f-4791-8cfa-f45b44bffa05: frican living in Africa and have a good command of both written and spoken English.
